concepts.label: Managing Cluster RBAC Users via the UserManager API

It is the SDK-side counterpart to server/'s CREATE USER/ALTER USER-type RBAC operations, but the page never names a SQL++ statement - it's a Java object model (User, Role) over the cluster management REST API, not over the Query service. See cross_product_finding.

cross_product_finding: PRIMARY FINDING for this page (directly addressing the registry's suggestion to check requiresCapellaRole here): despite the coordinator's hint that this page 'looks like a strong candidate' for the Capella management-plane role gate, the actual page content contains NO reference to Capella, organizations, or projects at all. Every role/privilege named here (Admin, data_reader, query_select, data_writer, query_insert, query_delete, query_manage_index) is a Couchbase Server data-plane RBAC role/privilege, assigned via the SDK's own UserManager API against a self-managed-style cluster connection. This page is about server/'s RBAC model as seen through the SDK's Java object wrapper (`Role`, `User`), NOT about Capella's organization/project role model - so requiresCapellaRole is NOT applicable here; I did not use it. This is a useful correction for the coordinator: the SDK's UserManager talks to the same data-plane RBAC system that server/'s CREATE USER/GRANT statements manage, so the more interesting reuse opportunity on this page is privilege:query-manage-index (data-plane), not requiresCapellaRole (management-plane) - the two access-control layers should not be conflated even though this page's title ('User Management') sounds superficially like it could be either.
